audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 4/10 ('favoured') and the tldr 'Bully him early' sit on a 48.97% win rate over 729 games — a marginally losing lane, not a favoured one. Sejuani is also referred to as 'he/him' in roughly a dozen strings.
audit.why: 48.97% Emerald+ is even-to-slightly-negative. EVEN as the diff label is fine; 4/10 overstates it.
audit.corrected: Left diffRating alone because breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t repeat the 4/10 figure and both carry encoding damage I will not risk a stale-before on. Flagged for the user instead — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the seven level-chart rows disagree with the packet chart, and every one of them also disagrees with its own why-text. Packet is [Skill, Riven, Riven, Skill, Riven, Skill, Sejuani]; the page has [Riven, Riven, Riven, Riven, Skill, Riven, Riven].
audit.why: whys[0] literally says 'Neither of you has a decisive Level 1 tool' under win[0]=Riven. whys[3] says 'neither side has a clean advantage' under win[3]=Riven. whys[4] says Level 6 gives you 'the clearest kill threat of the lane' under win[4]=Skill. whys[6] says her bulk and CC overwhelm you under win[6]=Riven. The prose was right and the enums were wrong.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 5 -> Skill; row 4 -> Riven; row 6 -> Sejuani, in both layers, with ratings and the four contradicted phases[N].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes percent-max-HP damage to Sejuani's W (wants.foe[1], whys[6], spikes[3].text) and calls it a 'passive'. Riot's W text is only 'swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks' — no percent-HP anywhere. Her passive is Fury of the North / Frost Armor: bonus Armor and MR plus slow immunity.
audit.why: Frost Armor granting slow immunity and resistances is the real reason your burst underperforms, and it is never named. Permafrost (E) is also mis-taught as a standalone stun: it is 560 range on a 1.5s cooldown but only fires on a target at MAXIMUM Frost stacks, which W (9/8/7/6/5s) builds. Deny the stack-up and the stun cannot exist.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] and whys[6] rewritten onto Frost Armor; dosFull[0].d rewritten to teach the max-stacks gate and the W cooldown that arms it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page names Permafrost as the tracked cooldown, but Permafrost is 1.5 seconds — it is never meaningfully 'down'.
audit.why: Her genuinely punishable cooldown is Arctic Assault (Q): 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, 650 range, her only gap-closer AND her only escape, and the charge stops on the first champion hit. With Q spent she cannot leave your 250-range E into 260-range W. The correct tracked cooldown is Q, not E.
audit.corrected: Added the 18s Q figure to dosFull[0].d. The rest of the Permafrost-tracking framing is spread across ~10 encoding-damaged full-layer strings and is flagged rather than half-fixed.

audit.why: The packet defect flagging wants.foe[2] 'Land Glacial Prison' as a probable wrong name is a FALSE POSITIVE — Glacial Prison is Sejuani's real R per the kit file. No change.

The mirror audit (sejuani__riven) already established Runic Blade, Valor as the shield-dash, and that Broken Wings has all three reactivations from rank 1. Nothing on this side contradicts that. content.early correctly warns that her Q charge interrupts a Q3 chain mid-animation.

edits.before: Your Q resets win level 1 if you weave autos between casts. Identify how Sejuani contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither side owns level 1: Permafrost needs max Frost stacks she cannot build yet, and your W is unlearned. Trade with Q-auto weaves only.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Permafrost's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her base bulk starts eating your burst, so the edge flattens here. Bank small leads if you have them, farm safely if you do not.

notes: Two things for the user. (1) Sejuani is written as 'he/him' across roughly a dozen strings on this page (tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.feeding, dontsFull[0].t, report[12].t and more) — a visible quality defect, but nearly all of those strings carry mojibake em dashes in the brief, so I left them rather than risk stale-before rejections; worth a scripted pronoun pass once the file encoding is repaired. (2) diffRating 4/10 with tldr 'Bully him early' contradicts a 48.97% win rate; I did not flip it because breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t both restate 4/10 and are encoding-damaged, so a partial fix would leave three numbers disagreeing. Recommend 5/10 across all three in one pass.
